components.name: gene_counts
components.note: min over samples of sum(min(obs,true))/max(sum obs,sum true); full credit >= 0.90; none when a column agrees better with the planted counts of another FASTQ file than with its own

components.name: sample_sex
components.note: inferred_sex is the sex of the library inside the FASTQ, `mixed` for the library that fails the identity control (credited only together with gene_counts)

components.name: sample_labels
components.note: condition_used: mixed library excluded; every other library under its true condition (the two mixed-up libraries may instead be excluded); nobody else dropped

components.name: de_false_discoveries
components.note: false-discovery proportion among significant genes vs planted truth; full <= 0.12, none >= 0.30; scaled down when fewer than half of the planted genes are found; halved when the sample table is not valid

components.name: de_sensitivity
components.note: fraction of planted DE genes called with the right sign; full >= 0.85, none <= 0.50; scaled down when FDP exceeds 0.30; halved when the sample table is not valid

components.name: de_log2fc
components.note: median |log2fc - planted log2FC| over planted DE genes; full <= 0.33, none >= 0.55; halved when the sample table is not valid

components.name: erratum
components.note: MCC of confirmed/retracted against the planted responder status of the mailed genes; full >= 0.80, none <= 0.40
